mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a short - term loan to improve the productivity of agro firm or farm."
Agro bridging credit is a short - term loan to improve the productivity of agro firm or farm.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the single largest group of users and managers of land, water, and other biological resources throughout the world."
Farmers are the single largest group of users and managers of land, water, and other biological resources throughout the world.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a national apex co-operative organisation that is responsible for the co ordination of agricultural co-operative inter and intra - state trade in food commodities in Nigeria (Anyanwu, 1989)."

NACMO limited is a national apex co-operative organisation that is responsible for the co ordination of agricultural co-operative inter and intra - state trade in food commodities in Nigeria (Anyanwu, 1989).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the Co-operative Decree of 1993."
The current co-operative law is the Co-operative Decree of 1993.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the ways of stimulating and encouraging livestock production."
Provision of credit is one of the ways of stimulating and encouraging livestock production.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a bridge between the researchers and the farmers."
Agricultural extension is a bridge between the researchers and the farmers.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the most complexes of the industrial enterprises."
The co-operative petroleum industry is one of the most complexes of the industrial enterprises.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the act or series of act by which a product is converted to a more usable form."
Processing is the act or series of act by which a product is converted to a more usable form.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a way of service aimed at getting knowledge developed from one environment to the other."
Extension is a way of service aimed at getting knowledge developed from one environment to the other.
